item.title: Timmons scores 23 for No. 21 Alabama women in 64-63 thriller over No. 13 Ole Miss
item.description: Jessica Timmons scored 23 points and grabbed seven rebounds, Karly Weathers added 14 points and six rebounds, and No. 21 Alabama took down No. 13 Ole Miss 64-63 on Thursday night.

item.title: Booker and Crump push No. 4 Texas over No, 5 LSU 77-64 as Longhorns run home win streak to 39
item.description: Madison Booker scored 18 points, Aaliyah Crump added 16 and No. 4 Texas used a big run at the start of the fourth quarter to pull away from No. 5 LSU for a 77-64 victory.

item.title: Bitcoin falls 9% and Asian shares slip after Wall Street is hit by tech stock losses
item.description: Asian shares are mostly lower after Wall Street extended losses driven by technology stocks.

item.title: Thompson returns from IR to lead the Capitals past Nashville. Now he heads to the Olympics
item.description: Logan Thompson returned from injured reserve and made 27 saves to lift the Washington Capitals to a 4-2 victory over the Nashville Predators.

item.title: Commanders star Bobby Wagner named Walter Payton NFL Man of the Year, honors mother lost to stroke
item.description: Bobby Wagner's mother always told him she believed he would make it to the NFL, encouraging him after her son's firing from the only job he ever had aside from football.

item.title: Passenger injured when handicapped accessible minivan stops suddenly, police say
item.description: After the woman hit her head on the dashboard during the incident in Hauppauge, the driver crashed into another vehicle, police said.

item.title: Luka Doncic leaves the Lakers' game against the 76ers with left leg injury
item.description: NBA scoring leader Luka Doncic left the Los Angeles Lakers' game against Philadelphia on with a leg injury.

item.title: Leaders of Indonesia and Australia sign a new security treaty to affirm deeper ties
item.description: Indonesian and Australian leaders signed a new bilateral security treaty that both governments say will deepen security ties between the two often-testy neighbors.

item.title: Bus carrying wedding party tumbles off mountainous road in Nepal, killing 13 and injuring 34
item.description: Police say a bus carrying a wedding party veered off a mountain road in west Nepal and tumbled down a slope in a crash that killed at least 13 people while 34 more were injured.

item.title: Oregon, Washington and tribes head back to court after Trump pulls out of deal to recover salmon
item.description: Lawyers for conservation groups, Native American tribes, and the states of Oregon and Washington are returning to court to seek changes to dam operations on the Snake and Columbia Rivers.
